annotations.title: Get a Country's AML Risk Profile

description: Look up one country's anti-money-laundering risk: FATF status (black/grey list), Basel AML Index, Corruption Perceptions Index, EU and US high-risk designations, tax-haven flag, and a derived risk level (critical, high, medium, low or standard). Use it to assess a counterparty's country or a payment corridor; it takes one country code per call, so check each end of a corridor separately. For a named person or company use run_due_diligence, which already assesses the countries found in its hits. A code not in the dataset returns found=false with risk_level unknown (a successful, charged call). Costs $0.001 USDC per successful call via x402 on Base; unpaid calls return an x402 PaymentRequired result and failed calls are not charged.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. MU (Mauritius), KP (North Korea), AE (United Arab Emirates)

name: get_jurisdiction_risk

found.description: False when the country is not in the dataset

lists_as_of.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) each screening list was last updated, keyed by list (e.g. us_ofac_sdn, eu_consolidated); check it before relying on a clear result

profile.description: country_name, fatf_status, basel_aml_score, cpi_score, is_high_risk, is_tax_haven, eu_high_risk, us_high_risk, region, fsrb

risk_level.description: From highest: critical (FATF black list) > high (FATF grey list, EU high-risk third country or flagged high-risk) > medium (tax haven, US high-risk designation or Basel AML Index above 6) > low (Corruption Perceptions Index below 40) > standard (none of these); unknown when not in the dataset

anyOf.description: Returned with isError=true when payment is needed: sign one of `accepts` with an x402 client and repeat the call with the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

accepts.description: Accepted payment options: scheme 'exact', network 'eip155:8453' (Base), USDC asset, amount in 6-decimal atomic units, payTo address

error.description: Why payment is required, or why the submitted payment was rejected

extensions.description: x402 protocol extensions (e.g. bazaar discovery metadata)

resource.description: The paid resource: url, description, mimeType

anyOf.title: x402 PaymentRequired

title: Get a Country's AML Risk Profile
